title: perf(research): cut overlap query wall time by 48.7%
body:
## Summary

Empirical tooling improvement with a scoped equivalence proof and finite regression evidence. The complete offline `joint-query-controller` overlap command takes **48.7% less wall time**, median **1.015105 s → 0.521243 s**, on the recorded workload. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

```diff
 numeric-reference lookup
+ if its mandatory literal number is absent, return no match
  otherwise run the unchanged boundary-aware regex
```

Every accepted regex match contains the escaped literal number. The new rejection is therefore exact; present numbers still receive the original boundary checks and offsets. Explicit literal queries keep their original path. Matches, scores, excerpts, ordering, coverage and warnings are preserved.

Produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Douglas Colkitt's overlap helper, Nick Petalas's #3002 numeric-reference rules, Ali Romman's #5736 Unicode excerpt handling and retained contributors. Literal prefiltering is standard; this contribution is its integration, complete-command measurement and controls. [Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19247052).

## Evidence

- Seven alternating runs per side, zero errors, all fourteen complete JSON reports identical after excluding only `searched_at`. Baseline range 0.994940–1.087073 s; candidate range 0.510642–0.535762 s. Both sides include interpreter startup, imports, local inventory, cached parsing, search and JSON output. Separate profiles identify regex scans as the removed cost.
- The external 16,945,386-byte cache contains 407 open PRs and 5,816 Discussion records. Sparse coverage and all 8,278 omitted-note warnings are retained. The package records the cache/source hashes and every sample in `BENCHMARK.json`.
- Normal and optimized checks pass 39,216 reference offsets, 39,216 literal offsets, eight complete search comparisons on 289 constructed records, and work/boundary controls. All 37 focused overlap tests pass. The three registered commands pass locally in 0.126, 0.198 and 0.710 seconds, each below 120 seconds.
- Committed-byte, source-history and executable-mode preflight passes at `1278601c6832bbecb47c2207240eede23f99a2fe`. Official eleven-file export integrity passes. Normal and optimized Git-free replays with empty PATH and read-only files pass, preserving all twelve exported file hashes.

Exact reproduction from the repository root, CPython 3.12 and standard library only:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/overlap-reference-prefilter/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/overlap-reference-prefilter
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/overlap-reference-prefilter --check-source-history --check-modes
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/overlap-reference-prefilter/benchmark.py --cache /absolute/path/overlap.json --samples 7
```

Expected correctness markers are `PASS_OVERLAP_REFERENCE_PREFILTER`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. Another CPython 3.12 installation may replace the local interpreter path. The optional benchmark needs Git and the pinned reachable main history.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

Timing is workload-specific. The historical public cache is hash-identified but not vendored, so the exact timing cannot be reconstructed from this package alone after that cache is removed. The harness accepts an external cache and checks all output fields on that workload. The deterministic verifier and CLI tests need no historical cache. No universal speedup is claimed for reference-dense corpora or other checkout layouts.

No supplier mathematics, native operator, full multiplier, selected cold replay, Lean or Docker is audited or run. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. All of this package's registered commands ran locally; none is deferred to CI.

## Open next questions

Does the same gain hold for other cards and a complete checkout? Run the unchanged harness on the intended immutable cache before optimizing a different mechanism. The first verified improvement is shipped here.

## Related open work

The completion refresh read this account's fifteen open PRs created since the CLAIM at 2026-10-28T16:15:54Z. No other submission changes this numeric-reference predicate or reports its complete overlap-command timing. These submissions also change shared verifier tooling under the same `replay-runtime` card:

- [#6155](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6155) defers mismatch-only digests in `scripts/check_research_commit.py`. It measures publication byte/history checking; this PR measures overlap search. Their timings are not compared or combined.
- [#6162](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6162) reuses authenticated publication metadata in `scripts/check_research_commit.py`. It removes duplicate Git reads in a different command; no combined speedup is claimed.
- [#6156](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6156) bounds working-source comparison memory in `scripts/research_package.py`. That module is a shared dependency of the overlap tool, but this PR retains the baseline module and claims no combined memory or timing benefit.

The other refreshed submissions study different constructions or quantities. No additional computations were run to compare their results.

## CI notes

**Uncertified by CI** at head `1278601c6832bbecb47c2207240eede23f99a2fe`. In [run 40726915850](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40726915850), [plan](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40726915850/job/122952542276) failed and [replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40726915850/job/122955171269) was skipped. **The package replay did not run in CI. A maintainer re-run is needed after main is fixed.**

The onboarding job reports `FAILED (failures=2, skipped=23)`. Its only two failures are the existing documentation mismatches on canonical main `721c03822c421b7f7fcbb2598993b947c4d88419`, the PR6030 kappa admission pushed with `[skip ci]`. That commit changed the selected record without matching the status marker and CI navigation:

- `test_research_current_status.CurrentStatusTests.test_current_section_matches_selected_record` expects standalone `**0.003125804**` in `docs/research/current-status.md`. Main instead bolds the larger expression `0.003125804 = 781451/250000000`.
- `test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record` expects `make frontier6030-verify`. The test reads `docs/ci-verification.md`; its current CI section still names #5599 and `make frontier5599-verify`.

[PR #6120 run 40691776027](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40691776027) fails the same two tests. Open [PR #6050](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6050) targets the documentation fix. The edits to `scripts/find_overlap.py` and its test introduced no additional failure in this onboarding step. This does not certify the skipped package replay. No code or documentation was pushed after the CI failure.

Local evidence remains separate: all three registered commands, normal/optimized direct checks, the 37 focused overlap tests, committed-byte/history/mode preflight, export integrity and Git-free replays pass. The broad local onboarding run initially had sparse-fixture errors; after materializing the omitted paths, all ten descendant-source-role tests and all fourteen queue-group tests pass. The complete local suite was not repeated after those targeted reruns.

Replay planning selects this package and three existing dependents. `overlap-discussion-batching` and `replay-input-head-spelling` pass their registered replays locally. `overlap-path-index` stops at `source blob provenance mismatch: scripts/find_overlap.py`. Its manifest is byte-identical to main and declares blob `34677253e224a8a2df51113dcd82b48f8826f81c`, while its declared base contains `2668844310ea52bb4fe3c4561dd4ee16fcdd20cc`. This pre-existing provenance inconsistency is preserved. That dependent's downstream replay is unrun after the metadata failure.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** coordination. Four shared-script lines, one regression test and one isolated research package. Existing source notices, frozen evidence and the selected frontier are preserved.
